discovery_scope: Canonical default public article URLs under clickhouse.com/blog, using the root sitemap, complete current RSS response and verified historical inventory. Localized blog routes, product, documentation and media surfaces are excluded.
terminal_evidence: The finite sitemap and RSS were fully parsed, each exposing 910 canonical article URLs. The union with verified historical inventory contains 911 routes, including a retained historical route absent from current maps. Every route was attempted.
gaps: One historical post contains only a short media announcement. Public HTML was fetched, but substantive prose extraction and media transcript coverage are unavailable.
Guessed blog feed and sitemap alias endpoints returned HTTP 404. Actual robots declared sitemap and complete RSS succeeded.
The dated asynchronous insert and backup blog accounts describe historical product behavior. Current owner contracts were checked before proposing guidance.
